scope: Read-only stdlib geometry of the original saved 88 requests per rank; no model/GPU/DT/algorithm/configuration change.
original_order: Exact saved context_tokens stable order and saved B4 sorted_rows; no reordering or new grouping.

definitions.L_i: Saved context_tokens, including original query and one target token.
definitions.slot_unit: One endpoint; B4 token slots. Paired B8 carriers multiply token slots by two without changing any ratio.
definitions.KV_byte_ratio: Same as physical_K/original_K only for a dense carrier with unchanged batch, heads, head dimension and dtype; not total GPU peak.
definitions.dense_rectangle_proxy: B4 * suffix_width * K_span; ignores causal masking, internal-hole unpadding, head dimensions, layer count and actual kernel scheduling. It is not FLOPs, measured FA reads or wall time.

logical_32768_bound.reason: P <=32704 because every 64-aligned cut precedes a nonempty suffix, and S <=32768. Maxima can come from different rows. These are representation bounds, not a new gate or a verified allocation.
logical_32768_bound.finite_compact_K_span: If the finite interface compacts the carrier back to max(L_i), its K-span ratio is 1; the physical carrier inflation above belongs to the proposed native cache representation.

limits: The population is the historical original 88-request payload, not the complete later formal DT population.
Dense carrier allocation ratios do not include cache forks, prefix bank, temporaries or allocator residency.
Official varlen unpadding may remove internal holes before native FA; these metadata do not measure that kernel or memory traffic.
Four original B4 groups have an increased dense rectangle proxy even though the aggregate proxy decreases.
No claim that suffix reduction or rectangular extent reduction translates to equal FLOP or wall-time reduction.
No tolerance, performance acceptance gate, configuration change or implementation is introduced.
